mapper.insert: insert into t_price_bidding(tender_number, customer_id, customer, customer_ip, materiel_no, materiel_name, initial_quotation, latest_quotation, quotation_time, quantity, mark_up, create_by, create_by_name, update_by, update_by_name,company_no,company_name) values (#{tenderNumber}, #{customerId}, #{customer}, #{customerIp}, #{materielNo}, #{materielName}, #{initialQuotation}, #{latestQuotation}, #{quotationTime}, #{quantity}, #{markUp}, #{createBy}, #{createByName}, #{updateBy}, #{updateByName},#{companyNo},#{companyName})
mapper.select: SELECT t_sales_bidding.id, t_sales_bidding.materiel_no AS materielNo, t_sales_bidding.materiel_name AS materielName, t_sales_bidding.bidding_mode AS biddingMode, t_sales_bidding.area_no AS areano, t_sales_bidding.area_name AS areaname, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_no AS deliveryPlaceNo, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_name AS deliveryPlaceName, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_class_no AS deliveryPlaceClassNo, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_class_name AS deliveryPlaceClassName, t_sales_bidding.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, t_sales_bidding.shipping_type AS shippingType, t_sales_bidding.low_price AS lowPrice, t_sales_bidding.starting_time AS startingTime, t_sales_bidding.bidding_duration AS biddingDuration, t_sales_bidding.delay_duration AS delayDuration, t_sales_bidding.sign_up_end_time AS signUpEndTime, t_sales_bidding.quantity AS quantity, t_sales_bidding.min_markup AS minMarkup, t_sales_bidding.distance_end_duration AS distanceEndDuration FROM t_sales_bidding WHERE t_sales_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber}
